changes: Job search looks up a job number and shows paint mixed, custom colors, formulas, lineup, and photos.
Recent jobs appear as cards on Job search — tap one to open it.
User activity check-in and check-out rows show the item name, and material usage times match the sign-in date format.
Waste dumped in the morning is counted as the previous workday.
Overview mixed and waste numbers only include completed days, not today.
Purchase orders keep the last loaded list on screen while they refresh.
Custom color check-in shows the stack location on the dashboard, and matching dye, stain, or toner steps are marked on formulas.
